chunks: And turn them into a level plain,

key_terms.صَفْصَفاً: smooth, bare, and empty of vegetation or obstacles
key_terms.قَاعاً: a flat, level plain or valley floor

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Qaan Safsafan' mean in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase describes the earth after the Flood or divine punishment, rendered 'flat and smooth' (qaa'an safsafan) to signify total purification and the removal of all irregularities. It highlights Allah's absolute power to reshape creation, serving as a reminder of the transient nature of worldly structures and the certainty of the Hereafter.
